General information.Name: market for natural gas liquids
General information.Description: This is a market activity representing the consumption mix of natural gas liquids in the global geography. The market connects suppliers with consumers of natural gas liquids within the same geographical area, grouping producers and imports. The activity starts at the gate of activities that produce natural gas liquids and ends with the supply to consumers. Transport and losses are considered irrelevant for this product. Natural gas liquids is a fossil fuel with a calorific value of 24.624 MJ/kg, used as a liquid fuel sourced from unprocessed natural gas. Main applications include domestic fuel for cooking and heating, industrial fuel, and plastics raw material.
General information.Tags: natural gas liquids, market activity, fossil fuel, energy distribution, global market
General information.Technology | Description: Market activity technology that represents the distribution and consumption mix of natural gas liquids. The technology groups producers and imports within the global geography and connects them with consumers. No specific processing technology is described as this is a market representation rather than a production process.
